entries.title: Search and filter accessible inventory
entries.reason: Project owner confirms inventory search/filtering is native. The reviewed Lua exposes the native filter/weight menu; exact full-text binding remains unverified locally.
entries.decision: Excluded by user-confirmed baseline; no replacement search implementation.

entries.title: Queue repeated ordinary actions with cancellation
entries.reason: Native timed-action queues already sequence actions and support cancellation.
entries.decision: Generic queueing/cancellation is not a new feature. Specific service playlists and selected-area planning remain separately reviewed.

entries.title: Find crafting recipes by inputs and outputs
entries.reason: The native recipe filter exposes RecipeName, InputName and OutputName modes.
entries.decision: Remove the replacement recipe-search proposal.

entries.title: Explain missing ingredients tools and stations
entries.reason: Native recipe info and input/tool widgets show requirements, alternatives, skill checks and available/used inputs.
entries.decision: Remove generic requirements explanation; no missing native outcome was established.

entries.title: Make food freshness safety and nutrition readable
entries.reason: Native food details and item tooltips already expose permitted cooking, hunger and food state information.
entries.decision: The generic readout requirement supplies no demonstrated additional workflow. Do not add hidden spoilage/poison knowledge.

entries.title: Search and explain available construction recipes
entries.reason: The native build panel instantiates searchable/filterable recipe widgets and native material/skill views.
entries.decision: Remove generic construction search and requirements browsing.

entries.title: Trace recipe dependencies and useful item applications
entries.reason: Native input/output widgets jump to recipes producing/using that item through the filter panel.
entries.decision: The existing proposal is navigable recipe relationships, not a separately specified graph planner; remove it rather than invent a new requirement to retain its score.

entries.title: Provide controller and scalable alternatives to mouse UI
entries.reason: Reviewed native panels implement joypad focus/navigation and native settings expose controller/font choices.
entries.decision: Remove generic controller/scaling support. A specific broken focus path would be a separately reproduced fix.

entries.title: Readable fluid identity amount and container compatibility
entries.reason: Native fluid panels already show amount/capacity and fluid details and provide transfer controls.
entries.decision: Remove the generic fluid readout/compatibility UI proposal; unknown contamination details are not grounds to invent a second panel.

entries.title: Center the map on the permitted current position
entries.reason: The native world map has a center button, C-key path and onCenterOnPlayer handler.
entries.decision: Remove generic centering; automatic follow is not independently established as a missing requirement.

entries.title: Readable map legend for native colors
entries.reason: Native world map creates ISWorldMapKey and toggles its legend.
entries.decision: Remove the proposed legend.

entries.title: Show known planting-season and crop information
entries.reason: Native farming tooltips show in-season and best-month data behind season knowledge/skill checks.
entries.decision: Remove generic seasonal information and preserve native knowledge gates.

entries.title: Clear and inspect alarms with fewer menu steps
entries.reason: Native inventory offers Stop Alarm and native alarm dialog allows enabling/disabling and changing its time.
entries.decision: Remove generic inspect/clear alarms; no distinct bulk-reset requirement was specified.

entries.title: Readable radio media controls and presets
entries.reason: Native radio UI has channel presets, adding/editing/deleting, battery, media and volume controls.
entries.decision: Remove generic presets/control readability as unspecified redesign, not new capability.

entries.title: Remember inventory panel layout and filter preferences
entries.reason: Native layout manager saves/restores window geometry/visibility and inventory panels have native layout state.
entries.decision: Remove generic window persistence. No separate missing filter persistence was proven.

entries.title: Control who may inspect personal medical details
entries.reason: Native medical checks already request permission, show a yes/no prompt and invoke the accepted check path.
entries.decision: Remove generic examination consent from this list. Remembered/revocable policies would require a separately proven scope and are not presumed absent from the engine.

entries.title: Improve preview and adjustment of item placement
entries.reason: Native placement has previews, surface selection, rotation and 3D offsets.
entries.decision: Remove generic placement preview/adjustment. New arrangement profiles or expanded collision bounds are separate content/mechanics, not a proven gap here.

entries.title: Share player-approved map annotations
entries.reason: Native annotation sharing supports private/everyone/faction/safehouse and selected-player visibility.
entries.decision: Remove the proposed annotation-sharing system.

entries.title: Pin known recipes and remember browse preferences
entries.reason: Native recipe list reads favorite metadata and renders favorite stars; filters include usage sorting.
entries.decision: Remove generic recipe pinning/browse preference functionality.

entries.title: Explain selected traits and occupations
entries.reason: Native character creation already presents trait/occupation descriptions and tooltips.
entries.decision: Remove generic explanations; no specific incorrect or omitted native value was identified.

entries.title: Name supported items for personal organization
entries.reason: Native context menu already renames supported bags, maps and food items.
entries.decision: The proposal explicitly uses native-supported naming; remove it rather than broaden renaming rights.

entries.title: Equip reachable ground items through a clear native action
entries.reason: Native ground-item context actions transfer/equip eligible items into primary/secondary hands.
entries.decision: Remove the generic equip-from-ground proposal; shortcuts are separately scoped.

entries.title: Explain valid vehicle repair and part choices
entries.reason: Native mechanics and part menus already show condition, tools, requirements and available repairs.
entries.decision: Remove generic repair explanation. New repair recipes are mechanics and service itineraries are separately reviewed.

entries.title: Make permitted clothing warmth and light state clearer
entries.reason: Native item/equipment/device UI already exposes permitted insulation, condition and active light/device state.
entries.decision: Remove generic property readouts; no specific missing display location or value was established.

entries.title: Review permitted personal kill and survival statistics
entries.reason: Native character screen already shows personal survival and kill statistics.
entries.decision: Remove the proposed recap of native counters; indirect/category attribution is unproven and not silently added.

entries.title: Explain visible weapon and ammunition properties
entries.reason: Native weapon/magazine item views and context menus already expose permitted properties and matching ammo actions.
entries.decision: Remove generic weapon facts display; no concrete missing property was specified.

entries.title: Batch ordinary packing unpacking and opening
entries.reason: Native recipes and container actions already support ordinary packing/unpacking/opening and repeated crafting.
entries.decision: No new recipe or cross-container planning scope was specified; remove the generic batch proposal.

entries.title: Legible character equipment and customization preview
entries.reason: Native character creation and character panels already provide 3D appearance/equipment previews and UI sizing.
entries.decision: Remove generic legible preview; a specific clipping/layout defect would be separate evidence-backed work.

entries.title: Make local mod errors easier to identify
entries.reason: Vanilla has an error window with refreshable Lua error entries and counts.
entries.decision: Remove the generic error-viewer proposal; opt-in redaction/export would need a separate concrete requirement.

entries.title: Preview supported item models without placing them
entries.reason: Native inventory page includes a 3D item preview path and native placement previews.
entries.decision: Remove the generic model viewer proposal; do not confuse the absence of a custom panel with missing model preview.

entries.title: Organize and explain enabled mod dependencies
entries.reason: Native selector includes ordering, requirement/load-before/load-after tooltips and mod-list presets.
entries.decision: Remove generic dependency/order management; do not replace native mod-list configuration.

entries.title: Find supported native rest and pose actions
entries.reason: Native context actions expose ordinary rest/sit/sleep workflows.
entries.decision: Remove generic discovery of existing rest actions. Additional poses/animations are separate content.

entries.title: Language fallback and readable localized interface text
entries.reason: Native localization, translated strings and UI font/language options already exist.
entries.decision: Generic localization is an implementation requirement for every retained feature, not a new scored capability. Specific missing translations need separate evidence.

entries.title: Make permitted sandbox settings easier to locate
entries.reason: Native SandboxOptions and server-admin sandbox settings UI already exist.
entries.decision: Remove another sandbox-settings entry point as a new feature.

entries.title: Open native extended-placement adjustment from an item
entries.reason: Native item placement and extended 3D adjustment already provide placement/offset controls.
entries.decision: Remove generic entry to native placement; a missing object-specific context entry would require reproduction.

entries.title: Discover and bind existing native emotes
entries.reason: Native emote radial and emote configuration already expose and bind supported native emotes.
entries.decision: Remove generic emote discovery; new animations are original asset/content work.

entries.title: Make existing note and identity inspection discoverable
entries.reason: Native readable literature, print-media and item inspection actions exist.
entries.decision: No authoritative unreadable-item defect was established. New stories or generated identities are content, not a generic UI omission.
